latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ITSM Security Maturity Assessment platform.

- Provides comprehensive security maturity assessments for eight core ITSM/ITIL processes.
- Supports real-time process scoring, maturity level evaluation, and actionable recommendations.
- Includes API endpoints for health checks, assessment submission, maturity levels, and process definitions.
- Designed for ITSM/security professionals to identify improvement opportunities and demonstrate compliance.
